subject: Passing variables between server.R and ui.R

messages.author: d452993da17e0f56
messages.subject: Passing variables between server.R and ui.R
parts:
I need to be able to load a dataset and then select which of its columns to display in a table. How can this be achieved? From what I understand, variables cannot be shared between server.R and ui.R, so if I load a csv dynamically into a data.table inside server.R, there is no way for me to pass its column names to ui.R to display in the appropriate box.

Thanks!

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: Passing variables between server.R and ui.R
parts:
You can create a file load input, and create a reactiveValue. When the reactiveValue get the csv dateset, create a multiple select input which has all the columns' names. Then create a datatable output and show only the columns selected. 
You may don't know the function renderUI
